task_message:
Case M38: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 280x280x450 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. Final summary:

**Case M38 — myxoid soft-tissue tumor (T2-weighted MRI, thigh)**

- **Lesion:** A large, multilobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense mass in the posteromedial thigh, with a very bright myxoid component and an intermediate-signal (more cellular) medial component, spanning axial 186–270, coronal 35–112, sagittal 38–122.
- **Approach:** Located the lesion on axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, seeded the model with 3 positive points across the bright core and the adjacent intermediate lobule (v1, 261 mL), verified the boundary on multiple slices in all three planes, then removed a small skin-surface structure (vessel/marker) at the inferior pole with a negative point (v2, 256 mL).
- **Final check:** Review of five slices per plane showed the outline tracking the lesion edge, no tumor tissue in any past-the-mask slice, one connected component, and all automatic candidates judged to be fat, muscle or vessel and rejected.
- **Confidence:** medium (boundary clearly matches the mass in all planes; some judgement call remains on the intermediate-signal medial component, which was kept as part of the lesion).
